tableGroups.wordCorrectionHint:
WORD TABLE CORRECTIONS (TABLE_INDENT_FALLBACK strategy):
  Uniform drift of -5.65pt across all 2 columns.
  Root cause unclear (cell padding and table indent do not match drift).
  Fix: reduce Table.LeftIndent by -5.65pt (-113 twips).
  This shifts the entire table left as a unit — do NOT apply per word or per phrase.
  Verify: Table.LeftIndent in source .docx = 0pt. New value should be 5.65pt.

WORD TABLE CORRECTIONS (COLUMN_WIDTHS strategy — single non-first column drift):
  Only Col[1] has observed drift: -5.65pt.
  Root cause: Col[0] width changed between versions, shifting Col[1] content.
  Fix: widen Col[0] by +5.65pt (113 twips).
  Do NOT shift Table.LeftIndent — Col[0] content is correctly positioned.
